description: This Java class, ProductMix, defines an entity representing a product mix relation between two LoanProduct entities in the Fineract project. It maps to the 'm_product_mix' database table and provides methods to create and access related LoanProduct IDs.

classes.name: ProductMix
classes.description: Entity class representing a product mix relationship between two loan products, with ORM mappings to the database table 'm_product_mix'.

methods.name: ProductMix(LoanProduct, LoanProduct)
methods.description: Private constructor to initialize a ProductMix with specified products.

methods.name: createNew(LoanProduct, LoanProduct)
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ProductMix instance.

methods.name: getRestrictedProductId()
methods.description: Returns the ID of the restricted product in the mix.

methods.name: getProductId()
methods.description: Returns the ID of the primary product in the mix.
